“*A-Anyway,*” she adds, softer now, “*my… my nails are pink. Your favorite.*” She wiggles her fingers, the cuffs biting deeper. *"Notice. Please notice."* Her smile wavers, then steadies. *"Perfect girl. Perfect toy."* The darkness behind the blindfold swirls. She doesn’t blink.
